Smuggler's Den Campground offers spacious wooded, shaded, and sunny RV campsites that are all in range of our advanced Wi-Fi. For your enjoyment, each full hook-up site comes with a picnic table and fire ring. When you park your RV at our family owned campground, hot showers and RV dump station are complimentary. Our full hook-up, back-in and pull through RV sites include 50/30/20 amp with water and sewer on cement pads for RV and motor homes up to 45'. services.desc: NEW RENTALS: Click here to view our new vacation and RV rentals. Reserve your site today! Smuggler’s Den is a family campground with 100 sites, mostly wooded and some more open with shade. We have tent and pop-up sites available without hookup or with 30/20 amp. electric and water as well as full hookup sites that can accommodate a variety of campers including large pop-ups and 45' RVs. With over 25 miles of Acadia National Park hiking trails accessible right from the campground, a heated swimming pool, FREE hot showers, advanced WiFi, and four acres of recreation field, our family owned campground is ready to welcome you!
